title: Want to jam on AI/Game design?
author: NoAutoPilotYT

comments.author: NoAutoPilotYT
comments.body:
We have a few posts in the community, we're Incite! an ex-Roblox,  Zynga, and Manticore team working of building the AI-story engine of tomorrow.  


This community has been super receptive to us, and we wanted to share we just opened our dev Discord. If you'd like to swing in and chat all things AI/ Game Dev feel free to come through.  


Community link - [https://discord.com/invite/aVTeZHJCSc](https://discord.com/invite/aVTeZHJCSc)  


Thanks and happy New Year!

replies.author: CharmingMagicGarden
replies.body: I love the engine! Looks really simple and cute

replies.body: Aye, thanks! I wish I could take credit for that, but it's all Dan. He has a bunch of cool behind the scenes stuff on X if you're interested. [https://twitter.com/DanFessler](https://twitter.com/DanFessler)
